# Mister KD — Kadir Demir

> “I build what the world snacks on next.” Kadir Demir (Mister KD) develops functional food and beverages from formulation to shelf. He is co-founder of Muscle Cheff (since 2015) and YOUNITED, and founding board member of Smarter Snacks and Bite & More.

## Product portfolio
- [My Creations](https://misterkd.com/#creations): 45 product creations across YOUNITED, Bite & More and Muscle Cheff, including bars and chocolate, cereal, puffs and chips, spreads, bakery and drinks.
- [The brands](https://misterkd.com/#brands): Kadir leads product design and development at YOUNITED. His work across the four brands includes product innovation, market expansion and retail partnerships.
- [About Kadir](https://misterkd.com/#about): a background in finance, audit and business development, applied to formulation, production costs and market fit. Insights from 100+ countries are framed as inspiration, not a distribution footprint.
- [The process](https://misterkd.com/#process): 1,000+ product trials. Ingredient testing, nutrition balancing, texture engineering, global benchmarking, consumer feedback and retail performance.

## Work with Kadir
- [Partnerships and co-creation](https://misterkd.com/#work): develop a snack or product line from concept to launch.
- [Product and innovation consulting](https://misterkd.com/#work): formulation, nutrition, texture, manufacturing partners and production costs.
- [Retail and distribution](https://misterkd.com/#work): market entry, distributor strategy and retail expansion.
- [Speaking](https://misterkd.com/#work): functional food, product development and building snack brands.
- [Prepare a project brief](https://misterkd.com/#contact): the form cannot send messages yet. Visitors can download a brief and share it through their existing contact. Downloading does not send an enquiry.

## Related brand
- [YOUNITED Gourmet Snacking](https://younitedsnacks.com/): protein candy bars, cereal cups, real-cheese puffs and spreads, made in the EU.

Product names and nutrition statements reflect the pack or formulation shown. This is Kadir's product portfolio, not an online shop.
